card.name: End of beta-lactamase inhibitor names
card.fires_on: The closing piece "am" in avibactam and relebactam, the beta-lactamase inhibitors paired with other antibiotics. It appears in dosing and combination-product text.

modes.label: avibactam
modes.description: The final "am" of avibactam beside ceftazidime or aztreonam, followed by a dose.

modes.label: relebactam
modes.description: The final "am" of relebactam in imipenem/cilastatin combinations.

card.plain: It fires at the end of the drug names avibactam and relebactam, usually where they are listed with a partner antibiotic and its dose.
